pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown irregular polygonal regions with jagged, serrated edge perimeters. Individual patches exhibit high spatial area; pixel-level edge gradients are soft due to image-wide blur.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative-space pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quad-radial; pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, light-colored pendulous convex mass is visible on the ventral-posterior midline.
